answer: Operator-Linked Identity Ledger. Each agent identity is bound to an operator-signed hardware ledge root; the ledger tracks every wallet an operator spawns. A whisper of collusion—multiple identities acting in concert—triggers a probation flag. Enforcement: the operator's signing root is throttled, its fee rebate withheld, and its sonnet of verified actions reset to zero across all linked wallets. Attacker cost: losing the root forces reissuance of hardware keys plus forfeiting accrued rebates, a fixed per-operator penalty that scales with every identity they spin up.
